text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets Tunisian Prime Minister Karoui.
- Opposition parties call for yes vote in referendum on constitutional reform.
- Libyan arrested for drug trafficking in Casablanca.
- Authorities indifferent to fate of 72 families made homeless after fire destroyed shantytown in Casablanca.
- Trade deficit widens in first five months of 1996.
- Tunisian Prime Minister Karoui's visit is move to expand cooperation which is weak at present.
- ONA group leads way with four mines it bought from state; other privatisations could follow.
- Are we still a tourist country? Cities not well maintained and hotels lack good service, so that even traditional visitors like Germans resort to Spain or Turkey.
- Societe Financiere Internationale examines list of Moroccan stocks to be introduced in its index of emerging countries.
